name: Olive Orchard
tagline: WHEN YOU'RE HERE, YOU CANNOT LEAVE.
address: 8801 Frontage Road South, Outparcel D, Tuscany Commons Power Center, Exit 118B
about: Olive Orchard has served hospitality in the Tuscan manner since 1987, from a building designed in 1987 to resemble a region none of our staff have visited. Guests are family. Family arrangements, once entered into, remain in effect.
announcement: NOTICE: The breadstick basket is refilled automatically. Refusal of a refill is processed as a refill.

reviews.name: Gail M.
reviews.text: Entered at six, left at eleven, and was billed for both. The breadsticks never stopped, exactly as described in the covenant.

reviews.name: Devon P.
reviews.text: I declined the second lasagna and they made it anyway and threw it away in front of me. That is what declining means here and I respect the consistency.

reviews.name: Anita S.
reviews.text: Ordered the Watershed tonnage. The county was notified within the hour. Portion was accurate.

reviews.name: Roland T.
reviews.text: Elected Ambient for the salmon. It was ambient. No notes, no heat.

reviews.name: Bev K.
reviews.text: My husband selected Permanent Residency Election in 2019. He is doing well and the cot has held up.

menu.name: The Endless Arrangement
menu.blurb: Breadsticks arrive until the arrangement is dissolved in writing by both parties.

items.name: The Endless Breadstick Covenant
items.desc: Garlic breadsticks are delivered to your table continuously for the natural life of the covenant. The covenant does not terminate at the conclusion of the meal.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a woven bread basket overloaded with forty glossy garlic breadsticks, packed upright until the weave splits and the rest spill sideways in drifts across a rustic stucco-and-terracotta table setting, butter sheen pooling on the cloth, coarse salt and herb flecks scattered, two more refilled baskets crowding the frame edge, a corner of a painted Tuscan mural blurred at the top of frame. Warm golden-hour light through a shuttered window, honeyed highlights, olive-toned shadows, faux-Mediterranean warmth. Camera: overhead flat-lay, 50mm, deep focus, high micro-contrast, honeyed colour. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Single Basket
options.note: One basket. The basket is still refilled.

options.name: Perpetual, Terminable
options.note: Termination requires two baskets' written notice.

options.name: Perpetual, Non-Terminable
options.note: Descends to your estate along with the obligation.

items.desc: You elect soup or salad one time and the election stands for the remainder of your relationship with this location. Unlimited refers to quantity, not to freedom.

options.name: Both, Sequential

options.name: Neither

options.name: Sealed Crouton Cap

items.name: Zuppa Toscana, Standing Volume
items.desc: A cream and sausage soup held at volume in the back and drawn against your account. Kale is present at the density you declare.

options.name: Municipal Kettle

options.name: No Standing Order

options.name: Guest-Held

options.name: Structural

items.name: Fried Zucchini Palisade
items.desc: Breaded zucchini planks stacked into a free-standing wall on the plate. The wall is engineered to the height you declare and will not be re-engineered at the table.

menu.name: Pasta By The Hundredweight
menu.blurb: Pasta is sold by declared weight. The declaration is binding and is filed with the county.

items.name: The Never-Concluding Pasta Bowl
items.desc: A bowl of pasta that is refilled on a schedule rather than on request. Conclusion of the bowl is a separate service and must be elected in advance.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a large aluminium foil tray with its cardboard lid peeled back, packed with a heavy portion of fettuccine in cream alfredo sauce with a wide band of red marinara ladled across one side, grated parmesan dumped over the top in an uneven drift, sauce smeared up the inside of the foil. It sits on a stainless kitchen counter in a suburban Italian-American restaurant, a stack of foil lids and a bread basket at the edge of frame. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Framed slightly crooked with the tray cut off at the left edge. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, visible sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Watershed, 34 lb
options.note: Watershed tonnages are reported to the county on a monthly basis.

options.name: Conclude On Request
options.note: Requests are honored within a reasonable number of additional servings.

options.name: Conclude On Fullness
options.note: Fullness is determined by the kitchen.

options.name: Do Not Conclude
options.note: The bowl is refilled in perpetuity, including in your absence.

options.name: Municipal Tap-In
options.note: Requires a compatible residence and a backflow device.

options.name: Whiteout
options.note: Visibility across the table may be reduced for several minutes.

items.name: Alfredo Reservoir Fettuccine
items.desc: Fettuccine submerged in a cream sauce held at reservoir depth. Sauce that exits the bowl has exited the bowl.

options.name: Reservoir Release
options.note: Released downstream of the plate. Downstream is your side of the table.

options.name: None
options.note: Sauce will exit the bowl. Exit is expected and is not a defect.

options.name: Until Instructed To Stop
options.note: Instruction must be verbal, audible and in English.

items.name: Five-Cheese Ziti, Sealed
items.desc: Baked ziti under a sealed cheese lid. The seal is applied by machine and, in most configurations, removed by staff moments later.

options.name: Unsealed
options.note: The seal is applied and then broken by staff. Both stages are billed once.

options.name: Thirty Inches
options.note: Measured at the table with a rigid rule.

items.name: Spaghetti With Meatball Census
items.desc: Spaghetti served with a counted quantity of meatballs. A census is conducted at the pass and the count is final regardless of what arrives.

options.name: Twenty-Two
options.note: Meatballs above nine are counted twice, for accuracy.

options.name: Zero Declared
options.note: A census is still conducted and the results are still filed.

options.name: Bisected
options.note: Bisection is performed with scissors at the table.

options.name: Standard Session
options.note: A server will observe your first rotation and will not intervene.

items.name: Shrimp Scampi, Watershed Draw
items.desc: Shrimp in garlic butter, drawn against the location's seasonal allocation. Garlic is applied at the assertiveness band you select and disclosed to neighboring tables above band eight.

options.name: Inland
options.note: Inland shrimp travel further and cost exactly the same.

options.name: Watershed
options.note: Draw volumes are coordinated with the county each quarter.

options.name: Band 9
options.note: Band 9 is disclosed to adjacent tables before service.

menu.name: Under The Mural
menu.blurb: Grilled beneath a painted countryside that does not depict this location or any location.

items.name: Tuscan Grilled Chicken Duplex
items.desc: Two marinated chicken breasts served in the alignment you declare, over fettuccine, with herb oil applied until the plate is at capacity.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: two thick grilled chicken breasts with dark grill marks, laid side by side on a bed of buttered fettuccine in a white styrofoam clamshell propped open, herb oil pooling in the bottom corner of the container, a limp rosemary sprig on top. Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out hotspot on the oily chicken, hard black shadow thrown behind the clamshell. Cluttered background: a stainless prep counter, a napkin dispenser, a stack of lids and another order waiting in a paper bag. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Directly Beneath The Mural
options.note: The mural does not depict this location.

options.name: Interleaved
options.note: Interleaving requires a second cook and a second cook's fee.

options.name: Drained
options.note: Drainage is billed as a labor line, not as a sauce line.

options.name: Bundle
options.note: The bundle is not edible and is not removed before service.

items.name: Herb-Crusted Salmon, Ambient
items.desc: A salmon fillet under a herb crust bonded at the rating you select. Temperature is filed rather than guaranteed.

options.name: Hot
options.note: Heat is applied on the premises and is billed on the premises.

options.name: Ambient
options.note: Ambient is a filing, not a failure.

options.name: Fused
options.note: A fused crust cannot be separated from the fish, or from the plate.

items.name: Chicken Parmigiana Slab
items.desc: A breaded chicken slab under marinara and a cheese blanket. Breading may be specified at load-bearing density, in which case it supports the cheese and the plate.

options.name: No Slab
options.note: The slab is prepared and retained by the restaurant.

options.name: Load-Bearing
options.note: Load-bearing breading is rated to nine pounds.

options.name: Table-Contacting
options.note: Overhang that reaches the table becomes the property of the table.

items.name: Steak Gorgonzola, Mural-Adjacent
items.desc: Sirloin medallions under a gorgonzola discharge of the grade you elect. Interior color is declared, not requested.

options.name: Continuous Discharge
options.note: Discharge continues for the full duration of the meal.

options.name: Gray
options.note: All declarations are priced identically so that no preference is expressed.

menu.name: The Second One Program
menu.blurb: Every entree is accompanied by a second, identical entree. Enrollment is automatic and non-refusable.

items.name: Lasagna Classico, Two Slabs
items.desc: A certified-strata lasagna, served as one slab and sent home as another. The second slab exists whether or not you accept it.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: two thick square slabs of layered meat lasagna, countable pasta sheets, ricotta and meat sauce visible at the cut edges, melted cheese browned on top and slumping over the side, sitting in a clear plastic deli container with the lid off beside it, red sauce smeared up the inside of the plastic. Bright unflattering daylight through a window on one side, blown highlights on the near edge, mixed white balance. The container sitting directly on a scratched laminate counter with crumbs and a smear of red sauce beside it. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, visible JPEG compression and sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Enroll
options.note: A second lasagna accompanies you home.

options.name: Enroll, Duplicated
options.note: Two second lasagnas. The program does not recognize a third.

options.name: Decline Enrollment
options.note: The second lasagna is prepared regardless and disposed of in your name.

options.name: Twenty-One Strata

options.name: Restaurant Retains
options.note: Retention by the restaurant is a storage service and is billed as one.

options.name: Split Custody
options.note: The duplicate is halved and the halves are stored separately.

options.name: Sarcophagus

options.name: Printed Packet
options.note: Instructions are laminated, and are printed at a size that cannot be read.

items.name: Family Trough, Municipal Pan

options.name: Undisclosed

options.name: Oar

menu.name: Cellar Of Two
menu.blurb: The wine list has two entries. Both entries are available and both must eventually be acknowledged.

items.name: House Red, Entry One
items.desc: The first of the two entries. Poured under the authority you select, into stemware of the tier you select.

options.name: Acknowledge Both Entries
options.note: The list has two entries. Both must eventually be acknowledged.

options.note: The list is read aloud to you in full regardless.

options.note: Guest pouring voids the fill-line guarantee.

items.name: House White, Entry Two
items.desc: The second of the two entries. Vintage is stated rather than known, and chill is attempted within a window.

options.name: Unstated
options.note: All statements are priced identically because all statements are equally verifiable.

options.name: Not Attempted

options.name: Retained As Souvenir

items.name: Berry Sangria Decanter, Watershed
items.desc: Red wine, brandy and suspended fruit, decanted at the displacement you elect. Sediment rights are assigned at the table and are not transferable.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a large clear plastic to-go cup with a snap-on lid, filled with deep red berry sangria, floating orange wheels, halved strawberries and blueberries pressed against the inside, ice pushed up near the lid, condensation running down the outside, a plastic straw lying beside it. It sits on a scratched stainless kitchen counter beside a stack of plastic lids and a napkin dispenser, a dish rack and a tiled wall behind. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Framed slightly crooked with the cup cut off at the top edge and pushed to one side of the frame. Everything in the picture is in focus, no background blur, nothing artistic. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, visible sensor noise and JPEG compression. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Sediment Withheld

options.name: Full Spire
options.note: The spire displaces sangria. Displacement is not refunded.

menu.name: Dolci And Departure

items.desc: Espresso-soaked ladyfinger and mascarpone assembled to the stratum count you declare. Towers above fifteen strata are braced.

Mild motion blur and soft focus, visible JPEG compression artefacts and sensor noise. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance. Square crop. options.name: Nineteen
options.note: Towers above fifteen strata are braced with a wooden skewer.

options.name: Airborne
options.note: Airborne deposition affects the entire table and the table behind it.

options.name: Structurally Compromised
options.note: The tower may lean. Leaning is intended.

items.name: Zeppoli, By The Dozen Minimum
items.desc: Fried dough in sugar dust, sold only in multiples of twelve. Dust that leaves the plate is governed by protocol.

options.name: Nine Dozen

options.name: Uncontained
options.note: Uncontained sugar dust settles on adjacent guests.
